verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner: headline, tagline, teal callout, and booking info are in a sensible order with good contrast. Flaws: the booking text is tiny and nearly illegible, the dashes are scattered fragments, and the callout wraps into three lines. B is a jammed cluster in the right half with a large dead area on the left. The headline is small and crammed at the top edge, and the lines are cramped and nearly touching. The tagline is centred against left-aligned lines, the dashed line is stranded at the bottom, and the booking text is microscopic. That makes it unusable.
